name: contour
description: Field attributes accepted by 'plot item create structure contour <attribute>' (3DEC 9.0).
notes: Append a single attribute after 'contour', then modifiers (above/below/interval/log/...).
Vector/tensor attributes (displacement, stress, strain-*) accept a component suffix (-x/-y/-z, -xx/-xy/...).
Probe live with 'plot item create <type> ?' to list top-level keywords, then 'plot item create <type> <kw> ?' for sub-options. Keyword sets here are binary-validated against 3DEC 9.0.
attributes_by_type_note: Contour attributes are PER ELEMENT TYPE on live 9.7 (the previous flat list mixed families): a common kinematics core (acceleration/displacement/velocity families incl. -magnitude and angular forms, convergence, extra, extra-node, link-displacement/-force/-gap-1/-gap-2 families incl. per-DOF forms, property, ratio-local, ratio-target, timestep-dynamic) plus per-type additions - beam: area-plastic, force/force-magnitude/-shear/-x/-y/-z, moment/moment-bending/-magnitude/-x/-y/-z, stress-max-plastic, stress-min-plastic; cable: force-axial, grout-confinement, grout-displacement, grout-stress, plastic-tensile-strain, stress-axial; liner (and geogrid/shell flavor): coupling-pore-pressure, coupling-stress-normal-effective/-total, coupling-stress-shear, pressure-applied, resultants + resultants-mx/-mxy/-my/-nx/-nxy/-ny/-qx/-qy, stress-elastic (+-intermediate/-maximum/-minimum/-xx/-xy/-xz/-yy/-yz/-zz), stress-plastic (+-maximum/-minimum). Verified against live 3DEC 9.7.47 ('?' enumeration), 2026-08-14.
